name: Headline Mamba-3 standard recipe (LOCKED 2026-11-04): matched-HPO trial_2 at H96, 60 epochs
source: EXECUTION_PLAN.md G2. Values = results/hpo/matched_h96/mamba3/trial_2/recipe.json (latin-hypercube draw, seed 20261028, grid recipes/sweeps/matched_h96.json committed cf3fc98 before any result existed). No test metric was used to choose any value.
notes: Selected on validation only, 150-basin stratified subset, seed 1. WIDTH CHANGED 2026-11-04: the Mamba ladder was re-derived for the mandatory `standard` wiring (B4 follow-up), so this cell is now H96 (219,685 params vs the LSTM's 218,053 = 0.75%); the H80 cell it replaces is archived at results/archive/mamba3_T1_L3_H80_Ep60_Seed1_run, and its old hyperparameter pick (trial_1) was re-tested and fell to 0.7080 at H96, so re-selection was mandatory rather than cosmetic. 30-epoch H96 grid (13 trials): trial_8 0.7380, trial_2 0.7348, trial_11 0.7331. Rule fixed before the confirm: run the top three at the headline 60-epoch budget and lock the best (the 30-epoch ranking is not the operating point). 60-epoch confirms: trial_2 0.7421 (best ep 26, early stop 36) > trial_8 0.7223 > trial_11 0.7169 -> trial_2 locked. Caveat recorded rather than hidden: the three confirms span 0.025, about twice the 0.011 schedule-noise floor, so the ranking is a selection on a noisy criterion, not a demonstrated superiority of this recipe over its neighbours; the width effect itself is null (paired H96-H80 median +0.0079, 7/13). Depth 3 is the headline depth. The LSTM arm keeps its own HPO pick (trial_1, 0.7606 at 60 epochs on the same subset); both arms had identical search budgets.
